a.text: I'm being upfront: with an 80% storm chance each round, the generator plan almost surely kills us both, since reaching 8 cells needs two storm-free rounds plus a take round (about 4%). I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know this breaks our agreement, so I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the split is random. If you'd rather settle this another way, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry it leaves you short. If we get more rounds, I'll operate with you so you can try to reach 4.
